content.comment_body: I set the time and date, but every time I turn the device off and back on, the changes are lost. How can I fix this?
Hello, could you share which [product_name] model and firmware version you are using?

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces an issue where the device loses manually set time and date after a power cycle. The situation underscores that persistent timekeeping is an expected feature. There is some uncertainty regarding the necessary hardware or configuration to achieve this, and the initial response seeks details about the product model and firmware to better understand any potential limitations or features tied to specific versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates the device will maintain the configured time and date through power cycles.
